why.title: Why the market rose today
why.summary: In plain words: the market rose, mainly because: shares rose in other big markets (like the US and Asia), which usually lifts the mood in India too. The news reasons below are matched automatically from headlines, so treat them as what's being reported, not proof.

points.text: The market rose: Sensex +0.7%, Nifty 50 +0.7%, Nifty Smallcap 250 +1.4%, Nifty LargeMidcap 250 +0.8%.
Small companies moved more than big ones (+1.4% vs +0.7%). Small and mid-sized stocks swing harder, both up and down.
More stocks rose than fell in your funds (175 up, 82 down).
Biggest drag on your money: Krishna Institute Of Medical Sciences Ltd (−1.7%), which cost you about ₹2,490 because you hold roughly ₹1.4L of it.
Helping most: PB Fintech Ltd (+6.0%), adding about ₹9,992 to your money.
Estimated effect on your funds: Axis Small Cap +1.14%, Mirae Asset Large & Midcap +1.11%, JioBlackRock Flexi Cap +0.66%. In total your portfolio moved about +₹1.2L (+1.12%).
Axis Small Cap moved the most. Funds holding more small and mid-sized stocks swing more than funds holding mostly large ones.
Shares rose in other big markets (like the US and Asia), which usually lifts the mood in India too.
